result.note: Tests the India–South Korea defence MoUs of May 2026, the KIND-X platform, and India's defence export figure for FY 2025-26.

questions.prompt: In May 2026, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh signed three defence Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) with South Korea in Seoul. Consider the following statements:
items: One of the MoUs covers defence cyber cooperation.
One of the MoUs provides for training exchanges between India's National Defence College and Korea National Defence University.
Rajnath Singh's two-nation tour, which ended in Seoul, began in Japan.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: The tour began in Vietnam, not Japan. The three MoUs covered defence cyber cooperation, training exchanges between the two national defence colleges, and peacekeeping operations.
questions.source: The Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) cover defence cyber cooperation, training exchanges between India's National Defence College and Korea National Defence University, and peacekeeping operations.

questions.prompt: During Defence Minister Rajnath Singh's visit to Seoul in May 2026, India and South Korea discussed operationalising KIND-X. What is KIND-X?
options: A joint platform for co-developing and co-producing defence systems
A biennial joint naval exercise held in the Indo-Pacific
A reciprocal military logistics support agreement
A joint satellite programme for maritime surveillance
questions.explain: KIND-X, the India-Korea Defence Innovation Accelerator Ecosystem, is a joint platform for co-developing and co-producing defence systems. L&T and Hanwha also signed two commercial defence technology agreements at a business roundtable Singh chaired in Seoul.
questions.source: Beyond the MoUs, both sides discussed operationalising KIND-X (India-Korea Defence Innovation Accelerator Ecosystem), a joint platform for co-developing and co-producing defence systems.

questions.prompt: According to figures cited by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh in May 2026, India's defence exports in FY 2025-26 were approximately:
questions.explain: Defence exports were nearly INR 40,000 crore (USD 4.7 billion) in FY 2025-26, while INR 1.54 lakh crore was total defence production. Singh said exports will reach INR 50,000 crore within two years.
questions.source: India recorded approximately INR 1.54 lakh crore (USD 18 billion) in defence production and nearly INR 40,000 crore (USD 4.7 billion) in exports in FY 2025-26.
